links.outcome: Appropriate triage of cases by difficulty level
links.effect: Triage distributions differed by case difficulty (p = 0.012), with appropriate triage declining from 85.7 % in level 1 cases to 66.2 % in level 3 cases.
links.quote: Triage distributions differed by case difficulty (p = 0.012), with appropriate triage declining from 85.7 % in level 1 cases to 66.2 % in level 3 cases.

links.outcome: Guideline concordance of impression and final category
links.effect: Overall impression concordance was 85.0 % (170/200), and final-category concordance was 77.5 % (155/200); concordance lower with greater case difficulty (both p < 0.001).
links.quote: Overall impression concordance was 85.0 % (170/200), and final-category concordance was 77.5 % (155/200).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance, usefulness, and potential harm of Gemini 1.5 Flash on 200 synthetic abdominal radiology cases rated by expert radiologists, but it evaluates standalone model capability across case difficulty rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
